description: Fetch a Facebook personal profile (个人主页) and its sub-pages. user accepts a numeric user ID or a username (both appear in profile URLs: /profile.php?id={userId} or /{username}). tab selects the sub-page: all (default, 全部 — mixed timeline of all posts), about (简介), photos (照片), reels (Reels), followers (粉丝), following (关注), friends (好友). List tabs scroll internally up to 100 items, partial=true when exhausted. Requires an active Facebook login; visibility depends on the target's privacy settings.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Numeric user ID or username of the profile. Both forms appear in Facebook URLs: facebook.com/profile.php?id={userId} or facebook.com/{username}. To find a user's ID/username, open their profile and copy it from the address bar, or use facebook/search --type people. (用户数字 ID 或 username；从对方主页地址栏复制，或用 search --type people 找人。)

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Profile sub-page: all (default, 全部 — mixed timeline of all post types, no sk param) | about (简介, sk=about, structured bio fields) | photos (照片, sk=photos) | reels (Reels, sk=reels_tab) | followers (粉丝, sk=followers) | following (关注, sk=following) | friends (好友, sk=friends, only visible if the target's friend list is public or you are friends). Implemented via the sk= URL parameter on the profile URL.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return (1-100, default 20). Applies to feed/list tabs (all/photos/reels/followers/following/friends); ignored for about. Scrolls internally; partial=true when the list ends early. (条数上限，仅帖子流/列表类子页生效；about 不适用。)
